question: The trio of Binoy, Badal, and Dinesh are remembered for their daring armed attack on which building, a symbol of British administration in Calcutta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Writers' Building**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The trio of **Binoy, Badal, and Dinesh** is remembered for their daring armed attack on the **Writers' Building** in Kolkata (formerly Calcutta), which was then a symbol of British administration in the city. 
• The attack took place on **December 8, 1930**, as part of the Indian independence struggle against British colonial rule. 
• The Writers' Building was targeted because it housed key British administrative offices, making it a significant symbol of colonial power. 
• During the attack, the trio entered the building disguised as civilians and assassinated **Colonel N.S. Simpson**, the Inspector General of Prisons, known for his oppressive measures against political prisoners. 
• After the assassination, a gunfight ensued between the revolutionaries and the police. Badal consumed cyanide to avoid capture, while Binoy and Dinesh were injured. Binoy later succumbed to his injuries, and Dinesh was captured and subsequently hanged. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Writers' Building:** 
• Located in the heart of Kolkata, the **Writers' Building** was originally built in 1777 to house junior clerks, or "writers," of the British East India Company. 
• It later became the secretariat building of the Government of West Bengal and is an iconic structure in the city. 
• The architecture of the building reflects a blend of Georgian and Greco-Roman styles, making it a historical and architectural landmark. 
• **Significance of the Attack:** 
• The assassination of Colonel Simpson was seen as a direct attack on the oppressive policies of the British colonial administration. 
• It marked a significant moment in the revolutionary movement in Bengal, inspiring countless others to join the fight for independence. 
• The courage and sacrifice of Binoy, Badal, and Dinesh are celebrated as a symbol of resistance against colonial oppression. 
• **Other Options:** 
• **Victoria Memorial:** An iconic marble building in Kolkata, it was built to honor Queen Victoria and is now a museum. It was not a site of revolutionary activity. 
• **Fort William:** A fort in Kolkata that served as a British military base. While significant, it was not attacked by Binoy, Badal, and Dinesh. 
• **Howrah Station:** One of the busiest railway stations in India, it served as a vital transportation hub but was not linked to this specific revolutionary act. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• The trio is often referred to as **Binoy-Badal-Dinesh**, and their actions are commemorated in Kolkata, including a statue in the **B.B.D. Bagh area** (formerly Dalhousie Square), which was named in their honor. 
• Their sacrifice is a part of the larger movement of revolutionary activities in Bengal, which included leaders like **Subhas Chandra Bose**, **Jatin Das**, and **Aurobindo Ghosh**. 
• The incident at the Writers' Building is often studied as an example of the courage and determination of Indian revolutionaries during the freedom struggle. </ul
